name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view: newest segment cards first with click-to-edit titles, drag to reorder, merge selected segments, arrow-key navigation, AI improve limited to selected segments with undo and cached results, hover insert / send groups that also target a fresh session, in-panel image previews, direct delete with a confirmation, rotating shortcut tips, copy-all that skips archived segments, the General Settings busy-send policy, image chips with automatic file cleanup, pending-count badges on the hidden button and sidebar workspace, scroll-safe auto refresh, resizable title-bar-safe panel, Ctrl+Shift+0 geometry reset, and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗：新分段置顶且空标题只在点击后显示输入框，可拖拽排序、合并选中分段、上下方向键切换分段、只对选中分段做 AI 优化，优化后按钮变为撤销并复用缓存结果；插入 / 发送按钮 hover 时展开为「当前会话 / 新会话」按钮组，图片支持面板内预览，可直接删除分段但需二次确认，底部快捷键提示可点击轮换，复制全部不再包含归档分段，发送行为跟随「设置 > 通用设置」中的繁忙发送策略；图片芯片删除时自动清理磁盘文件；隐藏按钮与侧边栏工作区显示未发送数量角标；自动刷新保持列表滚动位置；可调整尺寸，Ctrl+Shift+0 复位位置和尺寸，浮窗不会越过窗口标题栏，并适配深色模式。
author: RestRegular

scripts.test: node test/note-store.test.mjs && node test/route.test.mjs && node test/client-smoke.mjs && node test/package.test.mjs
